blocks.label: materialized view
blocks.code:
-- Create materialized view
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW dept_stats AS
SELECT dept_id,
  COUNT(*) AS emp_count,
  AVG(salary) AS avg_salary,
  SUM(salary) AS total_salary
FROM employees
GROUP BY dept_id;

-- Refresh (full rebuild)
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW dept_stats;

-- Refresh CONCURRENTLY (zero-downtime)
REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY dept_stats;
-- Requires: unique index on materialized view
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_dept_stats_dept ON dept_stats (dept_id);

blocks.label: continuous aggregate
blocks.code:
-- TimescaleDB continuous aggregate
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW hourly_events
WITH (timescaledb.continuous) AS
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS bucket,
  device_id,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count,
  AVG(value) AS avg_value
FROM events
GROUP BY bucket, device_id;

-- Automatic refresh (background)
-- Add refresh policy
SELECT add_continuous_aggregate_policy('hourly_events',
  start_offset => INTERVAL '3 hours',
  end_offset => INTERVAL '1 hour',
  schedule_interval => INTERVAL '1 hour');

-- Real-time view (combines materialized + raw)
SELECT * FROM hourly_events WHERE bucket > now() - INTERVAL '1 day';

blocks.label: incremental aggregate pattern
blocks.code:
-- Table for incremental aggregates
CREATE TABLE daily_sales_agg (
  sale_date DATE PRIMARY KEY,
  total_sales NUMERIC,
  order_count BIGINT
);

-- Incremental refresh (daily)
INSERT INTO daily_sales_agg (sale_date, total_sales, order_count)
SELECT sale_date, SUM(amount), COUNT(*)
FROM orders
WHERE sale_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1
GROUP BY sale_date
ON CONFLICT (sale_date) DO UPDATE SET
  total_sales = EXCLUDED.total_sales,
  order_count = EXCLUDED.order_count;

blocks.claim: A materialized view always shows the latest data from the base tables.
blocks.refutation: A materialized view is a snapshot at the time of last REFRESH. It does not automatically update when base tables change. You must manually REFRESH or use a continuous aggregate (TimescaleDB) for near real-time data.
blocks.correctModel: Materialized views are stale until refreshed. Use REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW (or CONCURRENTLY) to update. For real-time data, use a regular VIEW or TimescaleDB continuous aggregate.

revisionCard: Parallel aggregate: workers do Partial Aggregate → Gather Merge combines
Materialized view + CONCURRENTLY = zero-downtime refresh (needs unique index)
Continuous aggregates (TimescaleDB): incremental, automatic, near real-time
Incremental aggregates: apply delta (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) to existing aggregate
Streaming aggregates: continuous view = materialized + raw tail; PipelineDB/pg_streaming
REFRESH CONCURRENTLY = brief lock swap; requires unique index on MV

glossary.def: Per-worker aggregate on data partition; combined at leader via Gather Merge.
TimescaleDB: automatically maintained materialized view with incremental refresh.
Pre-computed query result stored as table; refreshed manually or scheduled.
Aggregate updated by applying delta (new/changed rows) instead of full recompute.
Capture INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE from WAL for real-time incremental processing.
